# ghost/newpipe

Search public YouTube in NewPipe without login; return visible titles, channels, views, ages and durations. Search-only: never opens a video.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/newpipe
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/newpipe open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/newpipe search_videos --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/newpipe read_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the public NewPipe home screen
- `search_videos`: Search YouTube and read visible video titles, channels, views and ages
- `read_results`: Read the currently visible search results
